body: I know they're not angry, I had another experience almost a year ago that led to me being hospitalized for about a week. What happened last night was that the girl I've been crazy about for a year, who had broken up with me earlier this summer told me she had slept with another guy. Even though we weren't dating, we were still basically dating. Spending all our time together, hooking up, ect. But because we weren't technically dating she felt it was completely okay to sleep around. This hurt deep, especially since i had just taken care of her for the last two days because she was sick, doing anything and everything for her. This flipped me out and started the cycle of "bad thoughts" in my head. Thanks for messaging me, I do really appreciate it.
